subject: Tenant provision & access plan — ACME AI initial org
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@acmeai.com>, Samantha Park <samantha.park@acmeai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Tenant provision & access plan — ACME AI initial org

Hi Alex & Samantha,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get ACME AI onboarded. I'm handing off to our implementation team to coordinate the initial tenant/org setup and user access so you can start integrating API keys and spinning up a dev project. Objectives for this thread:

- Confirm org/tenant naming and region
- Agree on environment separation (staging vs. prod) and initial projects
- Decide on auth approach (API keys vs. SSO + SCIM) and RBAC roles
- Outline timeline & next steps for provisioning and invites

Please see the attached tenant-provisioning-template.xlsx and our mutual-action-plan.docx — they include the fields we typically need. To help us prepare, please confirm the following by end of day Monday if possible:

1) Desired org/tenant name to appear in the console (e.g., acmeai-prod)
2) Primary region for hosting/metadata (us-east-1 vs us-west-2)
3) Will you use Okta for SSO/SCIM? If yes, we’ll need SAML metadata and an administrator contact.
4) Number of initial seats and the list of users to invite (we can do bulk invites).
5) Whether you want dedicated projects for staging and prod or a single project with environment flags.

Plan: once we have answers we’ll provision a sandbox org, generate scoped API keys for initial integration, and invite the users with appropriate roles. Dev (cc’d) will be your implementation lead. Priyom will help with RBAC and IAM mappings.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 17 Feb 10:00 PT — does that work?

Best,

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: tenant-provisioning-template.xlsx (spreadsheet), mutual-action-plan.docx (doc)

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant provision & access plan — ACME AI initial org

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few quick answers and clarifications from our side:

- Org name: acmeai-redwood (prod) and acmeai-redwood-staging (staging) — we prefer separate orgs for strict isolation.
- Region: us-east-1 for prod, staging can be us-west-2 if that simplifies capacity.
- SSO: yes, we use Okta. I'll attach the metadata and our SCIM admin contact (Samantha).
- Seats: initially 6 (2 eng, 2 product, 1 security, 1 ops). We may add more after POC.
- API keys: we need short-lived keys with rotation guidance. Also want a service account pattern for backend calls (no human-owned keys).

A couple of questions:
1) Can Redwood provision service accounts that are restricted to a single project and scope (generate tokens with only generation and embedding scopes)?
2) What is the recommended RBAC mapping for "product" vs "engineering" vs "security" roles — we want least privilege by default.

I can do the kickoff Tue 17 Feb 10:00 PT. Attaching Okta metadata (okta-metadata.xml).

Thanks,
Alex
VP, AI Platforms | ACME AI
alex.green@acmeai.com

Attachments: okta-metadata.xml

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant provision & access plan — ACME AI initial org

Great — thanks for the quick answers and the Okta metadata. To answer your questions briefly:

- Yes, we support service accounts (non-human) that can be scoped to a single project and limited scopes. We’ll provision a "svc-acme-backend" account for your backend integration pattern and issue a key tied to that account.
- RBAC recommendation: Product -> "Viewer + Prompt Editor" (no key generation), Engineering -> "Developer" (can create scoped API keys, manage projects), Security -> "Admin (audit-read)" role with additional audit/log access; we can customize. I’ll ask Priyom to propose a concrete mapping below.

Next steps before the kickoff:
- Dev (implementation lead) will create the two orgs (prod + staging) in our console and provision the initial projects.
- We will generate one scoped service account key and one limited dev key for your engineers to integrate locally. Keys will be time-limited and rotateable via the console or API.
- Priyom will post an RBAC mapping doc + the Terraform snippet we recommend for provisioning the roles and service accounts.

Dev & Priyom — can you prepare the sandbox org and the initial keys and share a short checklist by EOD Monday? Alex/Samantha — if you can send the initial user list (name, email, desired role) that helps speed invites.

Thanks,
Marissa

On a related note — Grace (CS Ops) will follow up about billing/account contacts to complete the Dedicated capacity form if you decide to reserve capacity later.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant provision & access plan — ACME AI initial org

Hi all,

Attached is the implementation checklist and the minimal Terraform snippet we'll provide in the shared onboarding folder. Summary checklist (high level):

1) Create orgs:
   - acmeai-redwood (prod, us-east-1)
   - acmeai-redwood-staging (staging, us-west-2)
2) Create projects:
   - prod-core, prod-embeddings, staging-dev
3) Create service account:
   - svc-acme-backend: scopes = [generation:write, embeddings:read]
4) API keys:
   - Generate one time-limited service key (30d) and one short-lived dev key (7d) for local testing. Use automatic rotation via API every 7d for dev keys.
5) RBAC mapping (initial):
   - Admin: marissa_cole, grace_oconnor (billing & user management)
   - Developer: dev@acmeai.com (eng leads) — can provision keys and manage projects
   - Product: product@acmeai.com — viewer + prompt editor
   - Security: security@acmeai.com — read-audit, log-export privileges
6) SSO / SCIM: configure Okta SAML assertion & enable SCIM push for user provisioning. Priyom: see below for attribute mapping.

Terraform snippet (example):
```
resource "redwood_org" "acme_prod" {
  name   = "acmeai-redwood"
  region = "us-east-1"
}

resource "redwood_service_account" "svc_backend" {
  org_id = redwood_org.acme_prod.id
  name   = "svc-acme-backend"
  scopes = ["generation:write", "embeddings:read"]
}

resource "redwood_api_key" "svc_key" {
  service_account_id = redwood_service_account.svc_backend.id
  expires_in_days    = 30
}
```
I'll create the two orgs and a staging sandbox by EOD tomorrow and post the generated keys (service key will be delivered via secure link).

Let me know if you want the dev key rotated more frequently — we can automate that.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: onboarding-checklist.md, terraform-snippets.tf
